Samir —

Thanks again for the demo last week. NimbleData was a great fit for the co-sell play and we want to move the GCP Marketplace listing + procurement setup along this week so we can hit the pilot timeline. I attached a quick procurement readiness checklist that covers the steps we typically need on the vendor side (SKU mapping, billing contact, PO flow, invoice schedule, public pricing vs metered variants).

Quick asks to unblock us:
- Can you confirm who in your finance/procurement team handles POs and whether NimbleData requires a net-30/45/60 term?
- Do you have an existing PO template you prefer? If so please attach.
- Any constraints around public pricing vs private pricing offers we should know for the listing?

I'll loop in Karthik to map the SKU/usage dimensions and Vanessa to surface co-sell billing handoffs. If helpful we can set a 30-min procurement sync this week.

Thanks,
Aisha

Aisha/Karthik —

A couple of technical clarifications from the packaging side before we finalize SKU mappings:

1) Meter granularity: Do we bill tokens or inference-seconds? Redwood supports token-based metering (recommended) and instance-hour metering for reserved capacity. If Nimble prefers token metering we need an agreed measure (tokens per API call average) for pricing examples.
2) Metering labels: We'll need the dimension keys (customer_id, project_id) surfaced in telemetry so GCP billing can attribute usage correctly. Can Karthik include these in the SKU mapping?
3) Reserved commit: If they want a committed monthly SKU, we should publish both a monthly recurring SKU and a separate overage meter to cover token overages.

I can draft the minimal telemetry + billing contract language for the listing once we confirm these choices.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

All —

Recap from today's sync (thanks Samir and procurement team for joining):

- Procurement: NimbleData will issue a PO with net-30 for the pilot. Procurement will send the signed PO to procurement@redwood.com.
- Invoicing path: For marketplace purchases during pilot, Redwood will invoice NimbleData directly (Google billing will be used only when customer purchases via the public listing). For co-sell pilot we agreed on direct invoicing so we can track credits.
- SKUs: Karthik to publish two SKUs on the draft listing folder: ND-RESERVED-MONTHLY (recurring) and ND-TOKENS-METER (metered by tokens). He will include telemetry keys: customer_id and project_id.
- Pricing: Nimble provided target ranges; Karthik to propose MSRP / private price delta in the draft listing doc.
- Next steps:
  - Procurement (Nimble): send PO to procurement@redwood.com by EOD Monday.
  - Karthik: populate SKU draft in Drive folder and share link.
  - Priyom: post a short billing/telemetry block for the listing that legal can reference.

I'll follow up with the runbook and invoice templates. Thanks everyone — moving this to the HubSpot deal (HubSpot:NimbleData-Deal-187) and adding tasks.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships Ops — Redwood Inference
